task: ae.ot operational transformation text editor core with client/server and simulation
reasoning_summary: Designed TextOp with a normalising builder and cursor-based compose/transform, a server that transforms stale ops over its log, and the three-state ot client. Tests were written first: literals, randomised property tests against naive apply and seeded multi-client simulations. One debug attempt fixed two wrong test expectations; five single-rule mutants were all rejected by the suite.
